incident_type.description: Category of the incident as described by the caller. violent_incident, suicide_or_attempt and extended_absence relate to the December 2025 model amendments, which apply only where adopted locally.

arose_from_work.description: The incident happened as a result of work (arising from the conduct of the business or undertaking).

serious_injury_criteria_met.description: For injury_or_illness: the caller has checked the injury or illness against the statutory serious injury or illness criteria for the jurisdiction. This pack does not encode the criteria.

serious_risk_exposed.description: For dangerous_incident: the incident exposed a person to a serious risk to health or safety, checked against the statutory dangerous incident criteria. This pack does not encode the criteria.
